{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gravity-wave system''' was a detonation method employing specialized circuitry embedded into the casing of a bomb. The system realized the strength of the gravity field around it, detonating whenever the level reached a preset threshold. Always very effective, the program could not be removed from the bomb without detonating. Adopted by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] when the [[M-12 sweep bomb|M-12]] failed to be effective, it proved to be advantageous in battles with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
